title: 第916章 无限溯源第915章 你不可能无限次
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
轰！
陈归尘的身影再次化作虚无。
神魂湮灭。
真灵消散。
连一丝气息都未曾留下。
姜夜静静站立，轻轻叹了一口气。
“又来了。”
话落。
他的目光望向虚无深处。
那里。
一道无形的时间波动再次浮现。
熟悉的气息。
熟悉的轨迹。
熟悉的光之定位锚点。
“这家伙还真是执着。”
姜夜摇了摇头。
下一刻。
时轮古盘缓缓转动。
无尽岁月之力再次汇聚。
他的身影踏入时间长河，跟随着那一道锚点，逆流而上。

……
一分钟之前。
陈归尘猛然睁开双眼，呼吸急促，冷汗瞬间从额头滑落。
他第一时间环顾四周。
熟悉的天地。
熟悉的时间节点。
一切都没有改变。
可是。
他的脸色却难看到了极点。
因为。
姜夜依旧站在那里，金色长袍，淡然神情。
“你…”
陈归尘死死盯着姜夜，声音都有些沙哑。
“为什么？”
“为什么你还能追上来？”
姜夜只是看着他。
没有回答。
而陈归尘的心，却已经沉到了谷底。
一次。
content_en:
boom!
Chen Guichen's figure turned into nothingness again.
The soul is annihilated.
The true spirit dissipates.
Not even a trace of breath was left.
Jiang Ye stood quietly and sighed softly.
"Here we go again."
The words fell.
His eyes looked into the depths of nothingness.
There.
An invisible time fluctuation emerged again.
A familiar scent.
Familiar trajectory.
A familiar anchor point of light.
"This guy is really persistent."
Jiang Ye shook his head.
The next moment.
The ancient wheel of time rotates slowly.
The power of endless years gathers again.
His figure stepped into the long river of time, followed the anchor point, and went upstream.
…
a minute ago.
Chen Guichen suddenly opened his eyes, breathing rapidly, and cold sweat instantly fell from his forehead.
He looked around for the first time.
A familiar world.
Familiar time points.
Nothing has changed.
But.
His expression was extremely ugly.
because.
Jiang Ye still stood there, wearing a golden robe and a calm expression.
"You..."
Chen Guichen stared at Jiang Ye, his voice a little hoarse.
"Why?"
"Why can you still catch up?"
Jiang Ye just looked at him.
No answer.
But Chen Guichen's heart had sunk to the bottom.
once.
